games.summary: New Version 1.5! Thank you for the feedback! It has resulted in many new features and improvements! Welcome to the Old West, where four wisecracking card sharks will try to take your money. You'll play against Annie, Cowboy, Gambler, and The Kid. Each player has his own unique style of play - and they'll help you learn how to play Texas Hold'em and Omaha Hold'em.Annie:Annie is a local that's been hanging around the Saloon and playing poker for as long as she can remember. If you're not careful, Annie will take your money in a big hurry! She doesn't like to lose so she'll fold on a weak hand but bet hard on a strong one.Cowboy:The Cowboy is a tough guy in for some hard-driving card playing! He's a tough one to figure out though. He spends most of his time out on the ranch so people around here don't see him much. When he does come to town, he likes to play poker. Sometimes he'll fold on a good hand and bluff a bad one. However, if he has a really good hand, he'll usually bet.Kid:The Kid is in town looking for a good time. He just got paid and he thinks he can pull a fast one on the locals. He's been in the Saloon just a bit too long and has had a bit too much to drink. He's not a very good poker player and makes mistakes. The longer he plays, the more chances you'll have to beat him.Gambler:The Gambler is a gruff old man. Nobody here knows where he came from, but he never seems to leave the Saloon. He's a "rock" and knows the odds of every hand - and he always plays the odds. He'll bet on a good hand and fold on a weak one.In addition to some interesting characters, there's an awesome, authentic saloon piano soundtrack performed by Squeek Steele! If you like her music (and you will), go check out http://www.goodoldsongs.com!Learn to Play:You have many options for hints and strategy. Hints are displayed to help you decide whether to Bet, Raise, Call, or Fold. The Strategy Mode gives you more information about your hand and your odds of improving. In the Pro version, you also have the option of seeing your opponents’ cards during the deal!Other Pro Features:* Individual Volume control for Sound, Music, and Voice effects* Save your game* Sort cards* Choose your cards to play in Omaha Hold'em * Choose players* Play one-on-one!* More Squeek Steele songs!NOTE: We hope you enjoy this game! Fright Train
games.summary:
Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelite. 

Fright Train is a third-person action survival horror roguelite in which you'll explore the monster-ridden corridors of an enormous train speeding through Antarctica. Keep it running by maintaining its parts, because if the train stops, there’s no telling what abomination might emerge from the blizzard to claim you...

A CHILLING ADVENTURE 
You play as a paranormal special agent responding to a distress signal sent from the L.R.S. Great White: a locomotive research station owned by the secretive SHARK corporation. Prepare to meet allies and encounter foes as you navigate the train's iron bowels. Monitor its condition and keep it running to avoid freezing to death or falling prey to the creatures chasing you outside! Will you be able to find the source of these horrors and put an end to them? 

HIGH-STAKES GAMEPLAY 
Scavenge the procedurally generated train for resources and unlock new cars and rooms by using the credits you gather, but don't forget to take time to prepare yourself for the waves of enemies that will appear during deadly storms! Credits will also let you purchase invaluable items at vending machines and upgrade your weapons. Get to the extraction point on top of the locomotive before the train reconfigures itself and complete small objectives to earn cosmetics! 

KEY FEATURES 

* Meaningful and tactical inventory management. Big and medium-sized items are physically displayed on the character, and the speed at which he can fetch them depends on where an item is located on the body: a magazine will be quicker to insert if it's stored on the chest rather than on the lower back!

* A volatile combat ecosystem in which enemy behaviors intertwine, allowing them to support or sabotage one another. Some enemies have armor and weak points: learn how to exploit their vulnerabilities and responses to attacks!

* A lived-in environment in which you'll find lore and many objects with which you can interact: vending machines for supplies, crates to kick, terminals to monitor and repair the train's parts, doors to unlock, and more!

* Semi-realistic stylized graphics and characters driven by a B-movie style story.

* A chilling and exciting adaptive soundtrack!

games.summary:
On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

RUNESCAPE AT ITS CORE!

Embark on quests, level your skills and explore a beautiful hand-crafted world.

This all-new adventure blends high-fantasy and iconic RuneScape lore on a brand new continent. RPG systems reward you with unique abilities and spells as you progress through each skill. Battle legendary RuneScape creatures like Zogres, challenge Black Knights and the entirely new and fearsome Garou, all set to a sweeping soundtrack of reorchestrated RuneScape classics and hours of brand new music.

GRIND SKILLS, SLAY DRAGONS

Locate them, throw down the gauntlet and carve your path to the Dragon Queen herself.

Your progress will be under constant threat from the looming shadow of the Dragons, as you arm yourself and prepare to rise to face them. Follow the trail of destruction and uncover the mysteries of the continent to learn not just how to confront the dragons, but how to overcome them. Prepare potions, craft gear and push yourself to do battle with the most powerful force on the continent.

The smart money's on the dragon. But we do love an underdog!

SURVIVAL THROUGH SORCERY

Summon a spectral axe to fell trees in an instant! Blink away from danger in a cloud of magic. Turn bones into... peaches?

The Anima-rich landscape of Ashenfall offers you a power unlike any other. Conjure a tornado of fish from a lake! Explode ore veins with a snap of your fingers! Journey through the vibrant regions of Ashenfall, discover why wild magic spills from the fractured lands and harness that power to survive!

COMMUNITY DRIVEN, PLAYER CENTRIC

Like all RuneScape games, community is at the heart of everything we do. We've shaped our entire roadmap based on player feedback, leading us to launch dedicated servers earlier than planned, introduce new combat and new quest content. Working together we're continuing to develop RuneScape: Dragonwilds. Whether you're adventuring with friends or going it alone, every opinion matters, and it's up to you to help us shape the future of our game.

games.name: Sukmantos Kitchen 1990
games.summary: Welcome to the wonderful ad-free world of Hangman Unlimited! Hangman is a fun, sometimes educational game where a person or computer picks a word, and a(nother) player tries to guess it by picking letters out of the alphabet.Usually, each wrong letter results in a drawn body part. To win, you have to figure out the complete word before the body is completely drawn! If you don't... it's game over.Hangman Unlimited is our first public project and... in the appearance sector, it falls short a bit. We apologize, but we feel we've made up for this with ease of use, stability and feature-richness relative to Hangman.We want everyone to take a look at these features, but more importantly, we want to welcome our first customers and bring quality content to the App Store.To help achieve both, we're providing everyone who tries the game in the first month with 250 free Gold (5X the normal amount)!Some common concerns from players of other Hangman games?♦ NO ads.♦ NO inappropriate words.♦ NO misspelled words.♦ NO multiple words combined into one (Barring those that are legitimate).♦ YES, every single word/phrase has exactly three hints.♦ YES, you can turn categories off if you don't want to guess the words in them.(Minimum number of categories: 4)Let's go over some features, shall we?♦ Up to one removed body part per game!♦ Up to one random letter per game!♦ Up to three hints per game!♦ Two player support (Locally)!♦ Game Center's leaderboard!♦ 150 words free, with over 500 more in packs of 30+!♦ Dictionary defines at the end of each game!(Dictionary does NOT work on phrases)For those curious: 787 total words so far, including the first 150.Planned Future for Hangman Unlimited♦ Multiplayer via Game Center♦ Graphics (Make it Prettier)♦ (More) Word Packs♦ Simplified Categories and Store♦ iCloud Support♦ Customization♦ Story Mode♦ Much, much more.We need your help to achieve all of this. If you like this game, help support us by giving us a review! Be sure to share your thoughts on what you believe can be improved, too. We'll see what we can do!If you're into harder words, or want to pick harder words for your opponents, we recommend taking a look at our Advanced Pack. 120 of the hardest-to-guess words we could find for Hangman!We try hard in all of our projects to avoid bugs, crashes and anything else considered frustrating or unsightly to a player. If you spot anything fishy, don't hesitate to let us know!
